title: Slash security accordion
description: A centred serif heading and grey line over two columns: an art panel with 12px corners on the left and, on the right, a borderless accordion of 20px points with thin chevrons; one point is open at a time and its text slides open while the chevron flips. On phones the open point carries its art inside it.
notes: needs JavaScript for the accordion (hydrate); static HTML shows the first point open
a little wider than the page column, as the original
